_zone.name: Torrox
_zone.description: Two faces in one municipality: Torrox Costa, with long beaches and a lively promenade, and Torrox village, white and Moorish among avocado-covered hills. It boasts of having the best climate in Europe.

faro-torrox.name: Torrox Lighthouse and Caviclum Roman Villa
faro-torrox.description: Beside the lighthouse lie the remains of a Roman villa with baths, a fish-salting factory and a pottery. The interpretation centre explains Roman Caviclum.
faro-torrox.short_tip: Free entry. Closed Sundays and Mondays.

torrox-pueblo.name: Torrox Village
torrox-pueblo.description: A white hillside village of Moorish origin, with narrow streets climbing from Plaza de la Constitución, surrounded by avocado and mango orchards.
torrox-pueblo.short_tip: Best on foot: park below and walk up. In December it holds its famous Migas Festival.

iglesia-encarnacion.name: Church of La Encarnación
iglesia-encarnacion.description: An early-16th-century church built on the site of the old main mosque, with a tower overlooking the village.

ermita-nieves.name: Convent of Las Nieves
ermita-nieves.description: A former 16th-century convent in Mudéjar style at the entrance to the village, whose cloister can be visited.
